# `fnox provider`

- **Usage:** `fnox provider <SUBCOMMAND>`

Manage providers (defaults to list)

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`fnox provider add [-g --global] [--vault <VAULT>] <PROVIDER> <PROVIDER_TYPE>`](/cli/provider/add.md)
- [`fnox provider list`](/cli/provider/list.md)
- [`fnox provider remove [-g --global] <PROVIDER>`](/cli/provider/remove.md)
- [`fnox provider test [-a --all] [PROVIDER]`](/cli/provider/test.md)

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Manage configured provider instances. The instance name, such as op, is distinct from the provider type, such as 1password.

```sh
fnox provider list
fnox provider test op
```
